queries.query: select case when total_mesas is null then 0 else total_mesas end as total_mesas from( select sum(m.valor_total) as total_mesas from mesa m where m.fecha_orden between :fechaInicial and :fechaFinal and m.estado_orden='A' )sub

SELECT CASE WHEN sub0.valor_total is null THEN 0 ELSE sub0.valor_total END as valor_total from( SELECT sum(m.valor_total) as valor_total FROM mesa m WHERE (m.id_dian is not null and m.id_dian > 0) and m.fecha_orden BETWEEN :fechaInicial and :fechaFinal and m.estado_orden='A' )sub0
